legend: User ainta decided to paint a wall. The wall consists of n2 tiles, that are arranged in an n × n table. Some tiles are painted, and the others are not. As he wants to paint it beautifully, he will follow the rules below.
Firstly user ainta looks at the wall. If there is at least one painted cell on each row and at least one painted cell on each column, he stops coloring. Otherwise, he goes to step 2.
User ainta choose any tile on the wall with uniform probability.
If the tile he has chosen is not painted, he paints the tile. Otherwise, he ignores it.
Then he takes a rest for one minute even if he doesn't paint the tile. And then ainta goes to step 1.

However ainta is worried if it would take too much time to finish this work. So he wants to calculate the expected time needed to paint the wall by the method above. Help him find the expected time. You can assume that choosing and painting any tile consumes no time at all.
input: The first line contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·103; 0 ≤ m ≤ min(n2, 2·104)) — the size of the wall and the number of painted cells.

Next m lines goes, each contains two integers ri and ci (1 ≤ ri, ci ≤ n) — the position of the painted cell. It is guaranteed that the positions are all distinct. Consider the rows of the table are numbered from 1 to n. Consider the columns of the table are numbered from 1 to n.
output: In a single line print the expected time to paint the wall in minutes. Your answer will be considered correct if it has at most 10 - 4 absolute or relative error.

legend.ai: 用户 ainta 决定粉刷一面墙壁。墙壁由 n2 块瓷砖组成，排列成一个 n × n 的表格。有些瓷砖已被粉刷，其余未粉刷。他希望把墙壁刷得漂亮，因此会遵循以下规则。
首先，用户 ainta 观察墙壁。如果每一行都至少有一个已粉刷的格子，并且每一列都至少有一个已粉刷的格子，他就停止涂色。否则，他进入第 2 步。
用户 ainta 从墙壁上等概率地随机选择任意一块瓷砖。
如果他选择的格子尚未涂色，就将其涂色；否则，他忽略它。
然后他休息一分钟，即使他没有涂那个格子。接着 ainta 回到步骤 1。
然而 ainta 担心完成这项工作会花费太多时间。因此他想计算用上述方法涂完整面墙所需的期望时间。帮他求出这个期望时间。你可以假设选择格子以及给任何格子涂色都不消耗时间。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^3；0 ≤ m ≤ min(n^2, 2·10^4)）——墙的尺寸和已涂色格子的数量。
接下来有 m 行，每行包含两个整数 ri 和 ci（1 ≤ ri, ci ≤ n）——已涂色格子的位置。保证所有位置互不相同。注意表格的行从 1 到 n 编号，表格的列也从 1 到 n 编号。

output.ai: 在一行中输出涂完整面墙所需的期望时间，单位为分钟。答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10^-4 即视为正确。
